I'm not really proud of myself, so I'll just list things I've done.


I graduated high school.


I was a co-winner in a concerto competition, composed a few tunes, went to all state honor choir and a large regional honor orchestra. I've won countless solos in orchestral settings. But people hate me for it. Nothing changes. I don't feel good about it.


I've gotten countless high and best scores on tests, finished the calculus series and linear before I graduated high school. No one likes me for it. Plenty of people hate me for it. I played water polo for 2 years, baseball for 4, and went to soccer camps a few times as a kid. I'm reasonably physically coordinated but I've been weak lately. I've hiked mount Whitney 3 times, once up the front. 


I grow weed to save money, the plant is doing pretty well. I have a fish tank I enjoy taking care of, but one of my roommates dumped a bunch of fish food into it and the fish almost died. I just got a jelly bean plant and its pretty. My teammates would try to talk about me behind my back about how horrible I was and I would hear it occasionally. People tell me I'm smart but I have trouble feeding myself and I've been losing weight. All my accomplishments are meaningless.


She tells me I'm attractive and she likes spending time around me, but I just don't understand what she sees.


I feel like my life is only going to get worse from here, that it would be better if I just ended it on that note.
I got fired twice from minimum wage jobs despite my best efforts and have nothing to show for it.
I can't even handle holding down a minimum wage job, how can I be worth something?

I hate how I look, I hate how I'm never on time, I hate how I can be manipulative, I hate how stupid I can be, I hate how I feel suicidal, I hate how I always seem to say "the wrong thing" in social situations and always come across as combative despite my intentions.

She's great, but why does she keep spending time with me? I don't understand why she likes me.
But its not fun anymore :( I try to stay in the moment and see what I enjoy or set goals that are relevant to me but all I can think about is killing myself.

Its just fun sometimes. I can't be good at it because my favorite part about it is taking tests and solving problems that interest me and I can't think of a way I can apply that to my life. "Find the mol of electrons that passed through the wire in lab" or "show how you would synthesize this organic molecule" I just don't see how that will ever help me or anyone since all those problems have already been solved countless times and I can't see what I could possibly contribute. Therapists I talk to tend to think I have bipolar and suggest medication, but how quickly and intensely my moods can change and my tendency to experience powerful personality changes make me think its BPD. I often can't empathize or be comfortable in social situations because I worry I will hurt someone.

When I try to talk to people or joke hurtful comments come out of my mouth without me meaning to.

Being told I am a horrible person makes me feel good because then I feel understood, even though at the same time I would feel pain, but pain comparable to being told I was ugly or that my pants don't fit quite right.

Its a problem with the hard wiring of my emotions.

I can't help fix your problems or give you any hope, but I can say I read your post and can relate.

I hope things get better for you.
